description: Conformance corpus for the structural checks every runtime applies when it loads a host manifest, before anything reaches the sandbox. Each runtime creates a runtime from `manifest` and asserts the outcome.
notes: A case with `valid: true` must load. A case with `issues` must be refused with a manifest validation error whose issues match exactly, path and message.

`slots` given as an object keyed by slot id is the shape a reader of other plugin systems reaches for. Without a load-time check it passed the runtime's light structural pass and failed later, inside hook injection, as an iteration error that named neither `slots` nor the expected shape.

The variadic, `optional`, and `{ type, description }` return cases pin that the runtimes accept the parameter shapes the schema accepts. No runtime enforces argument counts, so a variadic parameter needs no runtime support beyond loading.

cases.name: slots as an array of declarations loads
slots as an object keyed by id is refused

issues.message: 'slots' must be an array of { id, accepts } slot declarations, not an object or other value

cases.name: slots as a string is refused

issues.message: 'slots' must be an array of { id, accepts } slot declarations, not an object or other value

cases.name: a slot entry missing accepts is refused

issues.message: each 'slots' entry must be an object { id, accepts } with a string 'id' and an array of strings 'accepts'

cases.name: a slot entry that is not an object is refused

issues.message: each 'slots' entry must be an object { id, accepts } with a string 'id' and an array of strings 'accepts'

cases.name: variadic, optional, and described-return parameter shapes load
